title: Pixel 11 Pro XL review: Snappier cameras can’t hide an iterative upgrade
summary: Google’s Pixel 11 Pro XL brings snappier cameras and genuinely useful AI features like Rambler, but its iterative upgrades may not be enough to tempt recent Pixel owners.
llm_summary: Google’s Pixel 11 Pro XL upgrades its camera system with faster performance and new AI tools—most notably Rambler, an on‑device feature that lets you seamlessly blend multiple shots into a single, polished photo. While these enhancements feel genuinely useful, the phone is largely an incremental refresh, offering only modest improvements over the Pixel 10 series and may not be compelling enough for owners of recent Pixel models to upgrade.
